findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

Numerous ants were observed on the floor by the sink next to the entrance to the bakery preparation area. The PIC was shown and prepared a work order for the issue. While that was taking place the employee currently in the area indicated that a work order had already been placed. The PIC was able to find the order in the system and show the inspector during the inspection. The order was placed on 10/10. No action was observed in their system since then in relation to this situation. The inspector will follow-up in 10 days for compliance or progress.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The corner molding at the mop sink in the produce room next to the bakery area was observed with the covering damaged and missing. The PIC was shown and instructed to repair prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all surfaces around sinks are smooth and easily cleanable to protect against mold growth.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. 

The hand sink in the produce walk in was blocked by crates on inspector arrival in the area. The PIC was consulted and removed the obstructions to correct the violation. Ensure that all hand sinks are maintained easily accessible at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing. 

1) Several locations throughout the facility have minor cleaning needing to be conducted. Sweeping is needed under shelves in the walk in coolers, on shelves on the retail floor and under/behind shelves in the walk in freezers. Moping also needs to take place in the walk in cooler in the bakery. Multiple locations were shown to the PIC conducting the walk through and they are instructed to ensure that regular cleaning is taking place to reduce/remove cleaning issues. Maintain the floors clean at all times. 2) Ceiling grates in the meat room and bakery back room are observed with large amounts of dust accumulation. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean often enough to prevent accumulation at these locations.
